findings.title: Secret material stored in a queue payload
findings.description: Raw invite tokens are written into jobs.payload, a JSONB column kept indefinitely, while invites stores only a hash of each token.
findings.recommendation: Keep only references in job payloads, and create or fetch the secret when the job runs.

findings.title: Possible insecure direct object reference on project routes
findings.description: Changing projectId in the URL returned 404 rather than 403 for a project of another organisation.
findings.recommendation: Verify that object-level authorisation is enforced.

findings.title: Administrative interface reachable from the internet
findings.description: The admin routes are served by the public API. Without the right header they answer 404.
findings.recommendation: Restrict administrative routes to the internal network or a VPN, in addition to the token.

findings.title: Formula injection in CSV export
findings.description: Project names beginning with =, +, - or @ are written to the CSV as they are, and run as formulas when the file is opened in a spreadsheet.
findings.recommendation: Prefix such cells with a single quote, or escape them.

findings.title: Weak hash used for credentials
findings.description: API keys are hashed with unsalted SHA-256 rather than a password hashing function.
findings.recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2 for credentials.

findings.title: Possible timing attack on token comparison
findings.description: A token is compared to stored values.

findings.title: Unauthenticated requests are not rate limited
findings.description: Requests with a missing or unknown key are answered without counting against any limit; each one is a database lookup.
findings.evidence: 2,000 requests in 60 s with random keys: all 404, none 429
findings.recommendation: Limit unauthenticated requests by client address.

findings.title: path-to-regexp: inefficient regular expression
findings.description: Routes with two parameters in one path segment can be made to backtrack.

findings.title: Unvalidated redirect
findings.description: Response may redirect to a user-controlled location.

findings.title: Bulk endpoint reveals existing invitations
findings.description: The skipped count tells the caller how many of the addresses were already invited, within its own organisation.

findings.title: Technology disclosed in X-Powered-By
findings.description: Responses carry X-Powered-By: Express.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: Responses do not set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
findings.description: HSTS is not set.
findings.recommendation: Set Strict-Transport-Security at the load balancer or in the app.

findings.title: TLS configuration allows CBC cipher suites
findings.description: The listener uses ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06, which still offers some TLS 1.2 CBC suites.
findings.recommendation: Use a policy without CBC suites if no client needs them.

findings.title: Stack traces may be returned to clients
findings.description: An error handler is present; check that it never returns error details.

findings.title: Personal data in logs
findings.description: Every request line logs the client's IP address; the log groups keep 90 days.
findings.recommendation: Check the retention against the privacy policy.

findings.title: Large request bodies accepted
findings.description: Bodies up to 1 MB are accepted.

findings.title: CORS not configured
findings.description: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is returned.
findings.recommendation: Configure CORS if browsers call the API.

findings.title: Random tokens generated with randomBytes
findings.description: Invite tokens are 24 random bytes, base64url.

findings.title: form-data: unsafe random boundary (development dependency)
findings.description: Used by tests only.

findings.title: tar-fs path traversal (development dependency)
findings.description: Used by the Prisma CLI when it downloads engines.

findings.title: Health endpoint does not check dependencies
findings.description: The endpoint answers 200 without touching the database.
